ceiling_directive: Derive a single rate formula on the residual wedge and prove matching same-class upper and lower bounds, including the benchmark d=n, sigma^2=log^2(en)/n.
improvement_directive: Complete the conditionally centered, exactly normalized shared-design prior at the benchmark with realization-wise radius control and bounded full-mixture total variation, then extend the resulting converse scale across the residual wedge and match it with a uniformly stabilized rare-cell estimator.
critique: The note proves a new empirical-mass upper bound and obtains matched parametric MSE only on the union d<=n with sigma^2 d^2<=n or u_{n,d}<=1/n; it does not determine the requested sharp frontier over the full parameter range. At d=n and sigma^2=log^2(en)/n, the lower and upper bounds remain logarithmically separated, while the only proposed converse repair is left as oeq:repair-benchmark-prior. The global-shift-prior lemma merely rules out one proof architecture and supplies no minimax lower rate in the residual wedge, so the opening frontier language is broader than the delivered partial-region characterization despite the later disclaimers. The projected paper score is constrained by this unresolved central wedge, the load-bearing bracket imported from a non-archival internal parent rather than proved here, and the absence of a quantitative application showing what the new sufficient region changes for the stated 401(k) consumer. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.2 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
